## Opsgenie side
Same API key as *Opsgenie: alert on case escalation*. Store it as `OPSGENIE_API_KEY`, allowed host = the API host you chose.

## How it works
- Runs when an escalation closes (trigger `case.escalation_closed`): `POST https://<API host>/v2/alerts/<alias>/close?identifierType=alias`.


## Ack to accept
To let an acknowledgement in Opsgenie accept the escalation in SOC Hub, open **Settings → Integrations → Escalation paging**: the card shows the inbound URL to paste into Opsgenie (an incoming webhook integration, action *Acknowledge*). It is tied to this tenant and keeps working until you rotate it there.
